chunks: Your creation and resurrection is but like that of a single cell. Verily He is all-hearing and all-seeing.
ai.seo_question: What does the Quran say about the unity of human creation and resurrection?
ai.summary: This verse, often cited in Shia exegesis to affirm the unity of the human species and the ease of resurrection, draws directly from Surah An-Nisa (4:1) to emphasize that all humanity descends from a single soul. It underscores God's omnipresence and omniscience, reminding believers that the Creator who initiated life from one source is fully capable of resurrecting them, a concept central to Shia theological discussions on the nature of the soul and the afterlife.
